slices.title: Scheduled Do run in execution-core
slices.summary: Runs a scheduled Do step as a bounded agent loop in a new execution-core scheduled_agent module that offers only contract-approved read-class tools, withholds any other effect visibly instead of pausing for approval, and reports outcome counts through a GetVersion-gated orchestrator branch that calls one activity. Off by default; a schedule without a contract never takes this branch.
